summary: A four-step horizontal stepper inside a glass card with Back and Next buttons that advance the step.
use: Multi-step flows such as onboarding or checkout where the user moves through ordered stages.
spec: `const steps` has 4 entries with a `label` field: Account, Profile, Billing, Review
Wrapper is `<Card material="glass" p="6" full>` with `<Stack gap="6">`
Back is `<Button variant="ghost" disabled={step <= 0} onclick={() => step--}>`
Next is `<Button variant="filled" disabled={step >= steps.length - 1} onclick={() => step++}>` and reads Finish on the last step
